report.scope: Apply code-reviewer's PBI-008 findings.json (verdict GO-WITH-CONDITIONS, 1 MEDIUM CR-1, 3 LOW CR-2/CR-3/CR-4) to the uncommitted change in worktree C:/Users/jdk/dispatch-board-worktrees/PBI-008 (branch pbi/PBI-008-stale-board, base d10d9e6), against PBI-008.md criterion L-4 ('the time comes from at, rendered through esc(); an unreadable at shows no text and logs no error; each case is pinned by a page check'). report.summary: 5 files modified (exporters/refresh.py, tests/test_refresh.py, site/index.html, tests/page.test.mjs; local/tests/test_conformance.py untouched this round). 2 page checks added (98 total in tests/page.test.mjs: 94 base + the 2 five-minute/corrupt-at strengthenings, covering 6 corrupt-at values and 1 hostile-at value across their assertions), 2 unit tests renamed (no test removed or weakened). Suites: python -m unittest discover -s tests = 307 passed; node tests/page.test.mjs = 96 checks passed; python -m unittest discover -s local/tests = 90 passed, unchanged count. Nothing committed, staged or pushed.

changes.why: CR-1 (MEDIUM): strengthen the meta/lastRefresh page checks so they fail if the rendered time is not derived from lastRefresh.at (two different at values under one frozen clock must render two different, exactly-matching formatted times) and add a hostile-at check pinning that markup can never reach the DOM, escaped or not. CR-2 (LOW): replace the single 'not-a-time' assertion with a loop covering null, 0, true, a number, an object and a bad string, all of which must render no text.

CR-2 (LOW): asOfInfo() now requires lastRefresh.at to be a string before constructing a Date, so null, 0 and true (which new Date() otherwise coerces to a valid 1970 date) fall into the same silent 'unreadable at' path as a bad string, per L-4.

CR-3 (LOW): renamed Cli.test_nothing_to_push and its companion Plan.test_commit_then_nothing_to_push, which named a behaviour ('nothing to push') the change deletes, to test_a_quiet_tick_prints_only_the_last_refresh_write / test_commit_then_a_quiet_tick_prints_only_the_last_refresh_write, naming what they now prove. Assertions and the explanatory comment are unchanged.

CR-4 (LOW): rewrapped the plan() docstring's 137-character run-on line to the file's usual ~100-115 character width, so the MassDelete/AnswersRefused sentence starts at the left margin instead of mid-line.

tests.covers: meta/lastRefresh 5-minute case now asserts the rendered time is exactly the formatted 'at' (verified to fail when the page's when(lastRefresh.at) is swapped for when(Date.now()))
two different at values under one frozen clock render two different, exactly-matching texts, pinning that the header derives from at, not the clock (CR-1)
corrupt at values (null, 0, true, a number, an object, 'not-a-time') each render no text and no console error (CR-2; failed against the pre-fix site/index.html before the guard was added)
a hostile at (img/onerror fragment) renders no text and no fragment of it reaches the DOM, escaped or not (CR-1's esc() clause)
renamed tests still assert main()/plan() print exactly one write (meta/lastRefresh) on an otherwise-quiet tick (CR-3)
full python -m unittest discover -s tests run, 307 passed
full python -m unittest discover -s local/tests run, 90 passed, count unchanged

acceptance.criterion: CR-1 (MEDIUM): a page check fails if the displayed time is not derived from lastRefresh.at, and a hostile at is escaped with no HTML injected and no console error
acceptance.evidence: New checkpoint feeds two different at values under one frozen Date.now and asserts two different, exactly-formatted texts; confirmed it fails (wrong time shown) when when(lastRefresh.at) is temporarily swapped for when(Date.now()) in site/index.html, then reverted. Separate checkpoint feeds at = '2026-09-11T12:00:00Z' and asserts asOf().innerHTML is empty and contains no

acceptance.criterion: CR-2 (LOW): a non-string at (null, 0, true, a number, an object) renders no 'data as of' text and logs no error, same as an unparsable string
acceptance.evidence: asOfInfo() now requires typeof lastRefresh.at === 'string' before constructing a Date. New loop in tests/page.test.mjs feeds null, 0, true, 12345, {} and 'not-a-time' and asserts asOf().innerHTML === '' for each; this loop failed against the unfixed site/index.html (null rendered 'data as of Jan 1, 01:00 AM (stale)') before the guard was added, confirming the test is real.
